title: AgentSec Project Dashboard
description: What `agentsec://dashboard/latest` returns: one document composing three planes that stay separate. `project` identifies the repository, `purple` is the existing four-axis rollup described by dashboard.schema.json, and `skill_assurance` is the Skill Assurance summary from its own bounded context (ADR 0008). Composition, not merging — a Skill outcome never appears in verdict_counts, axis_counts or a PurpleVerdict, because the two planes answer different questions and a single number that averages them answers neither. Computed in memory on every read; nothing is written to serve this document.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this composite shape. The major component changes when a consumer would break; see reporting.publish.PUBLISH_SCHEMA_VERSION.

redaction.description: Publication manifest. Present on every projected document, so a reader can tell a withheld field from an absent one.

project.description: Which repository this is. `status` is not decoration: a dashboard for a repository that was never initialised must say so rather than render as an anonymous but healthy project.

status.description: declared: a valid .agentsec/project.yaml was read. not_initialised: no manifest — run `agentsec init`. invalid: a manifest exists and does not load, which is a reason to distrust the identity rather than to invent one.

surfaces.description: Counts only. The inventory itself is not part of this document.

skillAssurance.description: The Skill Assurance plane. Always `not_tested` while skill_eval is unbuilt (ADR 0008, issue #14), with a reason distinguishing 'nothing to test' from 'nothing to test with'. An unbuilt evaluator reports not_tested; it never reports a pass.

status.description: Deliberately not a PurpleVerdict. Skill outcomes are their own type and are never folded into the four-axis verdict.
